instruction.text: Look at the modal verb and adverbs and select the sentence which indicates a similar degree of possibility.

atoms.b: I will possibly buy a new bike.
I will probably buy a new bike.
I will undoubtedly buy a new bike.

Look at the modal verb and select the most appropriate adverb.

atoms.b: I ((++absolutely possibly)) must remember to pick up eggs from the supermarket on the way home.
She ((++probably potentially)) should wipe the ice cream off her face before going into the classroom.
Although he ((++occasionally always)) may make mistakes, overall he is an excellent student.
Jonny should ((++probably maybe)) wash his clothes more often.
He ((++surely likely)) must be the better player, given he’s scored far more goals.
It will ((++undoubtedly perhaps)) be warmer in Spain than Scotland this summer.
